proposal.reason: Main change is in transport connection setup and P2P transport behavior: transport selection/progress reporting, host↔device stream synchronization during connect, P2P connect gating, and P2P IPC address return semantics. Added memory because the PR also introduces new shareable SHM handle/descriptor lifecycle (allocate/import/close, refcount/unlink ownership) that changes host/device shared-buffer mapping and resource-release behavior beyond a purely mechanical caller edit.
